notes:
**Status: pending approval by Christian.** CHR-925 (design for CHR-906 settings menu, CHR-907, CHR-908).

**Trigger.** New icon button at the far right of the topbar, after the `Live` chip: `chrome-icon-btn`, 28px, Material Symbol `settings`, tooltip "Settings" (no shortcut). Open state = the `hover` fill (no new variant). **The interim theme toggle (`contrast`, shortcut T) is removed** — theme now lives only in this menu. The topbar (`shell-topbar`) is shared by all CHR-925 screens; `app-shell` itself is untouched and still shows the old toggle.

**Menu.** `chrome-menu` look: 288px wide, 4px padding, radius.menu 8, `chrome-shadow-float`, right edge aligned with the topbar padding (right 12px, top 48px), z 10. Section labels 11px tertiary, hairline dividers with 4px margin.

**Group 1 — App settings**
- Theme row, 36px: label "Theme" + `chrome-segmented` (216x28, System / Light / Dark, icons `brightness_auto` / `light_mode` / `dark_mode`, 12px). Selected = raised fill + border-strong ring + medium weight. Radiogroup semantics (`role=radiogroup`/`radio`), arrow keys move, persisted browser-locally.
- Five `chrome-toggle-row`s (30px, switch 28x16, knob 12px; on = `chrome-accent`, off = `chrome-border-strong`): Follow agent by default (off), Board clusters (on), Board edges (on), Variant map (on), Tags in sidebar (off). `role=switch` + `aria-checked`; whole row is the click target; the menu stays open after a toggle.

**Group 2 — MCP setup.** `chrome-menu-item-detail` (40px, icon `electrical_services`, label "Connect AI tools…", sub "3 of 6 connected" 11px tertiary). Flow: opens `shell-mcp-setup-dialog` (closes the menu).

**Group 3 — About Artisign.** Static row (30px): "Artisign 2.1.1" left, update status right (11px, `check_circle` 14px in `chrome-ok` + "Up to date"). Then `chrome-menu-item` `action` "What's New" (icon `new_releases`) -> flow to `shell-whats-new`.

**Update status states (same row, not drawn separately)**
1. Up to date: `check_circle` (ok) + "Up to date".
2. Update available: `upgrade` icon (accent) + "Version 2.2.0 available" on the row; the row becomes two lines (30px -> 40px, like `chrome-menu-item-detail`) with the sub line in code font: `artisign update`, with a 24px copy `chrome-icon-btn` sm at the right. Same copy as the toast of `shell-update-notice`.
3. Update check off (`ARTISIGN_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`): `block` icon (tertiary) + "Update check off" in tertiary text; no action.
Menu keyboard: Esc closes, Up/Down move between rows, Enter/Space activates; focus returns to the trigger.
